organization.label: Organization
organization.title: Your organization
organization.description: Stamped as the owner of the concept sets edited here. You can change it later in Settings → Branding.

branding.label: Branding
branding.title: Name and colors
branding.description: How the dictionary presents itself. Only the primary and secondary colors are customisable; the rest follows from them.

access.label: Access
access.title: Who can read
access.description: Editing always needs an account; reading can be open to anyone.

repository.label: Repository
repository.title: Content repository
repository.description: The git repository holding the dictionary's JSON files. Your answers are committed to it as config.json.
repository.head: Commit
repository.unavailable: The content repository could not be read.
repository.env: It is set in the server's environment, not here: DD_CONTENT_REPO_URL (cloned at first start), DD_CONTENT_BRANCH, and DD_GIT_TOKEN for pushing. Change them and restart the server.
